title: Patch: every Core Alt art somewhere else: the same subject in a new place, time or moment, one brief per card
notes: Core's Alt art pass (#3330, on #3392's scenes). Every Core card offered Alt art, 61 of them, now draws an alt scene recipe of its own from a brief per card (R3398000): its subject restaged in another place, time or moment, under a sky sharing no colour with its normal picture's and a new camera (a close-up, a wide or distant view, or one from above or below), where Alt art had redrawn the normal scene from another seed. A figure keeps the normal picture's person, Duplicating Felinors, Carnivorous Cube and True Strike their people; Ceaseless Void's Alt art is the void before it wakes, a black pearl in a tide pool, without its giant. Every Alt art level draws the one alt picture, base and Radiant; each clears its rarity's detail floor and the byte ceiling, and in a real browser changes at least 60% of the normal window's sampled points (ALT_PICTURE_CHANGE_MIN). Repaints keep the normal recipe. The scene kit gains a palm, a camel, a crater, a van, a hay bale, a picnic blanket, a rug, a hammock, a sleeping bag and a teapot. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.
